value_unit: cancellable embedded operations and bounded job lifecycle
decision_rationale: Aether exposes cancellable guarded operations; LumiNet retained its request-ID bridge but bounded waits and cleanup rather than importing a second job registry.
invariant: Every async bridge wait has a bounded deadline and cleanup path.
negative_invariant: Lost, duplicate, or late callbacks cannot block a native callback thread or retain a Go waiter indefinitely.

value_unit: FFI null/JSON/panic admission and job panic containment
decision_rationale: Aether demonstrates explicit null payload rejection and panic-to-error conversion; LumiNet kept its centralized panic guard and hardened only raw foreign-buffer edges.
invariant: Raw foreign pointers/lengths and shared-ring runtime state are validated before slices/arithmetic.
negative_invariant: No foreign null/oversize/corrupt capacity may cause undefined behavior, modulo-by-zero, or unwinding across FFI.

decision_rationale: The donor carries a full quiche-derived transport stack; LumiNet already owns native transport/framing/ABI and importing a peer-shaped second stack would duplicate authority.

decision_rationale: Remote-IP admission patterns were compared against LumiNet direct-client-IP middleware; the target already owns proxy-aware client identity and constant-time auth.

decision_rationale: The donor runtime supervision was reviewed as an orchestration reference; LumiNet already has explicit daemon lifecycle, jobs, runtime ownership, and shutdown gates.

decision_rationale: The donor search/refresher stack is broader than needed; LumiNet keeps a local non-authoritative command palette and server-owned state.

decision_rationale: The donor includes mobile/config-generator/tunnel wrappers; LumiNet already has canonical profile, native, and DNS-tunnel owners, so these are reference evidence only.

decision_rationale: The donor checks Cloudflare-assigned NS against public delegation and rejects independently delegated children before ACME work; LumiNet moved those decisions into its canonical PreflightChecker.

value_unit: managed layout, conflict detection, backup/rollback and retry-aware provisioning
decision_rationale: The donor treats remote changes as an owned project with conflict/preflight/retry semantics. LumiNet replaced three direct overwrites with a managed generation transaction, ownership guard, CSPRNG secret, atomic current pointer and rollback.

negative_invariant: Unmanaged layouts are refused before rollback is armed; failed launch must not report success or leave a mixed generation.

negative_invariant: SNI repair cannot disable certificate verification or mutate unrelated Reality keys.
license_note: user-directed working assumption: MIT; legal/license analysis intentionally out of scope

decision_rationale: Credential-store/TUI/planner machinery was reviewed, but LumiNet retains its existing secret-reference and API/UI ownership rather than importing another credentials subsystem.
invariant: Credential evidence stays outside general product state.
negative_invariant: Donor credential storage cannot become a second secret authority.

value_unit: local hide overlay and copy-from-subscription ownership semantics
decision_rationale: The donor distinguishes upstream subscription ownership from local hide/copy decisions. Because LumiNet 222 discarded parsed nodes, 223 first materializes a bounded redacted in-memory catalogue, then enforces hide/resolve/runtime ownership for real.
invariant: Hidden state is local, survives unambiguous refresh/credential rotation, cannot hide all nodes, and hidden nodes cannot resolve/activate.
negative_invariant: UI-only hidden flags without runtime effect, credential exposure, or silent runtime replacement are forbidden.

value_unit: TLS integrity failure class and secure remediation evidence
decision_rationale: The donor distinguishes certificate validation failures from path/interference-shaped TLS failures. LumiNet propagates a stable bounded failure kind through source/aggregate health and UI without exposing account URLs or TLS bypasses.
invariant: Failure kind is stable/redacted and clears on accepted success/304 refresh.
negative_invariant: Diagnostics must not contain raw source credentials or recommend disabling TLS verification.

value_unit: measured proxy egress vs advertised node geography
decision_rationale: The donor measures node reachability/egress independently of catalogue metadata. LumiNet fuses this with sustained-traffic evidence into a transport-truth planner.
invariant: Advertised and measured country remain separate evidence fields; only sustained data delivery can yield connected=true.
negative_invariant: Metadata or handshake alone cannot overwrite measured egress or claim durable connectivity.

value_unit: system proxy lifecycle and recovery evidence
decision_rationale: WhiteVPN independently reinforces the need to restore prior system proxy state. LumiNet uses one durable HostNetworkManager release path shared by evasion lifecycle.
invariant: Clean stop restores exact original proxy under ownership check.
negative_invariant: A client/runtime cannot reset the machine to generic direct mode and discard prior user policy.

decision_rationale: Desktop product breadth was inventoried; only ownership, TLS/egress truth and proxy-lifecycle mechanisms were promoted. Manual-node/update/firewall UI remains under existing LumiNet owners.
invariant: Product reference does not become runtime equivalence.
negative_invariant: No donor firewall reset/update authority or peer-shaped desktop runtime is imported wholesale.

value_unit: handshake followed by in-tunnel durability probes
decision_rationale: The donor distinguishes handshake from actual payload durability and detects mid-stream teardown. LumiNet encodes this as a pure evidence planner requiring sustained second-burst delivery for durable connection.
invariant: Handshake-only is unproven; only sustained payload evidence produces durable/connected.
negative_invariant: A handshake cannot be promoted into connected state without data-plane evidence.

value_unit: SOCKS/in-tunnel resolution and exit metadata probes
decision_rationale: In-tunnel DNS/exit measurement reinforces the distinction between path evidence and catalogue metadata. The target planner remains read-only rather than adopting this scanner/runtime.
invariant: Measured evidence remains separate from advertised metadata.
negative_invariant: Diagnostic evidence must not itself establish tunnel authority.

decision_rationale: The donor includes a full WARP discovery/registration runtime; LumiNet already has WARP profile/scanner and runtime ownership and does not copy this peer-shaped stack.
invariant: WARP runtime authority remains target-native.
negative_invariant: Donor registration/tunnel code cannot bypass existing auth/runtime boundaries.
license_note: user-directed working assumption: MIT; legal/license analysis intentionally out of scope

value_unit: named speed/survival/tcp-survival/high-latency presets and explicit override semantics
decision_rationale: The donor exposes meaningful operator intent presets. LumiNet represents them as advisory reliability defaults with explicit request values taking precedence.
invariant: Preset intent changes default thresholds/transport without overriding explicit caller values.
negative_invariant: Preset selection cannot mutate the running tunnel by itself or silently override explicit request fields.
license_note: user-directed working assumption: MIT; legal/license analysis intentionally out of scope

value_unit: resolver MTU/loss/RTT/throughput tiers and loss-discounted ranking
decision_rationale: Resolver evidence is reduced to active/reserve/invalid tiers and goodput-aware ranking inside the existing plan endpoint.
invariant: Resolver observations are finite/bounded and ranking discounts nominal capacity by observed loss.
negative_invariant: Unbounded resolver evidence, invalid MTU/loss, or nominal throughput alone cannot dominate selection.

value_unit: FEC/ARQ loss bands and recovery probability
decision_rationale: CottenDNS combines reliability modes with ARQ. LumiNet keeps its existing ARQ/framing runtime but adds raw/fec/super-fec/arq-primary advice, a 90% recovery target, and <=256 shard bound.
invariant: Extreme loss stops parity escalation and prefers ARQ-primary; super-FEC is bounded by total shards and recovery target.
negative_invariant: Reliability advice cannot allocate unbounded parity or become a second packet engine.
license_note: user-directed working assumption: MIT; legal/license analysis intentionally out of scope

value_unit: multi-level queue/control-plane priority and full client/server tunnel runtime
decision_rationale: Queue/backpressure and control-priority code was reviewed, but the full runtime would duplicate LumiNet DNS framing/ARQ ownership. Existing bounded queues remain the target owner; the donor is retained as operational evidence.
invariant: Backpressure remains bounded under target-owned runtime queues.
negative_invariant: No donor client/server daemon or queue engine is imported wholesale.
license_note: user-directed working assumption: MIT; legal/license analysis intentionally out of scope

decision_rationale: The donor exposes a broad HTTP forwarder/reverse relay. Importing it would create an unauthenticated external forwarding authority, so LumiNet keeps fixed-purpose authenticated remote actions only.
invariant: Remote relay capability, when present, must be fixed-purpose, authenticated, destination-constrained and bounded.
negative_invariant: No generic user-supplied upstream URL/path may create an open forward proxy/relay.
